# PDFium notices

The application bundles `@hyzyla/pdfium` 3.0.0 from npm. Its published package
contains the wrapper MIT license but omits the PDFium notices added upstream.
The accompanying notices were retrieved from the upstream repository:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hyzyla/pdfium/ff2083e4109840ce4157ec59ccdb1b253271d0bf/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

Bundled pdfium.wasm SHA-256: `beeaf5bbff216d555fecec7cd486072838c4632a2272d31b52ef1fd05008fe7c`.

These notices are also embedded in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and the HTML.
